{{Quote|Let others play at politics - we're in the shipping business|Old Man Haj|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Haj''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who founded the [[Haj Shipping Lines]]. Supplying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Haj secretly allowed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents to stowaway aboard his ships, raking in the extra income from their passage fares.
